schema.description: Client-scoped request for an agent the caller can edit.

agent_id.description: Identifier of the agent whose limit the request concerns.

client_id.description: Explicit opaque spend-client ID, retained without normalization and not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application. Control characters and the synthetic __deleted_clients__ aggregation ID are not valid spend-client IDs.

business_justification.description: Explanation of why the increase is needed. Required, and nonblank, when the workspace's request-more configuration requires an amount and business justification.

desired_limit_amount.description: Desired total agent limit for the current UTC month. Required when the workspace requires an amount and justification.
desired_limit_amount.title: PlatformDesiredLimitAmount

schema.title: PlatformAgentRequestCreate
